def compute_model_placement(gpu_num, models):
    """Place models size-first, then repeatedly apply the relocation minimizing max KVPR."""
    placement = {i: [] for i in range(gpu_num)}
    free = [GPU_MEM_SIZE] * gpu_num
    load = [0.0] * gpu_num

    for model in sorted(
        models, key=lambda m: (m.model_size, m.req_rate / m.slo), reverse=True
    ):
        pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
        best = min(
            (i for i in range(gpu_num) if model.model_size <= free[i]),
            key=lambda i: load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf"),
            default=None,
        )
        if best is None:
            raise ValueError("Models do not fit in available GPU memory")
        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= model.model_size
        load[best] += pressure

    # Take the best improving relocation; when none exists, try exchanges
    # that can unlock capacity-constrained improvements.
    for _ in range(2 * len(models)):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score, action = max(ratios), None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size, pressure = model.model_size, model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if src == dst or size > free[dst]:
                        continue
                    remaining = free[dst] - size
                    score = max(
                        (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size) if i == src
                        else (load[dst] + pressure) / remaining if i == dst and remaining
                        else float("inf") if i == dst else ratios[i]
                        for i in range(gpu_num)
                    )
                    if score < best_score:
                        best_score = score
                        action = ("move", src, dst, model, size, pressure)

        if action is None:
            for src in range(gpu_num):
                for dst in range(src + 1, gpu_num):
                    for left in placement[src]:
                        ls, lp = left.model_size, left.req_rate / left.slo
                        for right in placement[dst]:
                            rs, rp = right.model_size, right.req_rate / right.slo
                            sf, df = free[src] + ls - rs, free[dst] + rs - ls
                            if sf <= 0 or df <= 0:
                                continue
                            score = max(
                                (load[src] - lp + rp) / sf if i == src
                                else (load[dst] - rp + lp) / df if i == dst
                                else ratios[i]
                                for i in range(gpu_num)
                            )
                            if score < best_score:
                                best_score = score
                                action = ("swap", src, dst, left, right, sf, df, lp, rp)

        if action is None:
            break
        if action[0] == "move":
            _, src, dst, model, size, pressure = action
            placement[src].remove(model)
            placement[dst].append(model)
            free[src] += size
            free[dst] -= size
            load[src] -= pressure
            load[dst] += pressure

            placement[src].remove(left)

            placement[src].append(right)

            load[src] += rp - lp

        placement[best].append(model)
        free[best] -= model.model_size
        load[best] += pressure

    for _ in range(len(models)):
        ratios = [load[i] / free[i] if free[i] else float("inf") for i in range(gpu_num)]
        best_score = max(ratios)
        best_move = None

        for src in range(gpu_num):
            for model in placement[src]:
                size = model.model_size
                pressure = model.req_rate / model.slo
                for dst in range(gpu_num):
                    if src == dst or size > free[dst]:
                        continue
                    src_ratio = (load[src] - pressure) / (free[src] + size)
                    remaining = free[dst] - size
                    dst_ratio = (load[dst] + pressure) / remaining if remaining else float("inf")
                    score = max(
                        src_ratio if i == src else dst_ratio if i == dst else ratios[i]
                        for i in range(gpu_num)
                    )
                    if score < best_score:
                        best_score = score
                        best_move = src, dst, model, size, pressure

        if best_move is None:
            break
        src, dst, model, size, pressure = best_move
        placement[src].remove(model)
        placement[dst].append(model)
        free[src] += size
        free[dst] -= size
        load[src] -= pressure
        load[dst] += pressure

    return placement
